# hush_pinot_access_privilege (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about a Pinot access privilege in the Hush Security platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hush_pinot_access_privilege" "example" {
  id = "apr-eu12345678"
}

output "name" {
  value = data.hush_pinot_access_privilege.example.name
}

output "grant" {
  value = data.hush_pinot_access_privilege.example.grant
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the Pinot access privilege

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the Pinot access privilege
- `grant` (List of Object) The tables the generated user can query through the Pinot broker. It gets no controller access. An empty grant means all tables (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grant))
- `name` (String) The name of the Pinot access privilege
- `type` (String) The type of access privilege

<a id="nestedatt--grant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grant`

Read-Only:

- `exclude_tables` (List of String)
- `tables` (List of String)
